articles.title: Bridging the AI production gap: Over 100,000 Indian engineers trained to Build with Gemini
articles.summary: India is seeing a significant shift in its technology workforce towards enterprise AI integration and solutions. The Build with Gemini initiative has trained over 100,000 developers and architects across several major organizations. This transition emphasizes the need for professionals skilled in engineering AI for production. Global System Integrators are crucial in facilitating this workforce transformation. The evolution aims to position India as a key player in AI architecture and engineering.

articles.title: OmniAnalytics BI: Executive Decision Support System Built with Streamlit and Plotly
articles.summary: 1. Introduction: The Era of Data-Driven Decision Making In the modern enterprise landscape, data is the most strategic asset of any organization; however, raw data lacks intrinsic value without context and interpretability. The primary objective of Business Intelligence (BI) is to transform transactional volumes into actionable intelligence, enabling executive leaders and operations directors to answer critical business questions: Which product categories and channels generate the highest net operating margin? How would a 5% price increase or a 10% operating cost contraction impact our EBITDA? Which customer segments yield the highest customer lifetime value (CLV) and purchase frequency? Historically, developing executive control cockpits relied either on heavy proprietary software suites (such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik) or complex full-stack web applications built on React/Angular paired with Django/FastAPI microservices.
